extensions.scope: Marketing style only (src/components/marketing/MarketingPage.astro, tokens scoped to .mk; speaker tokens --sp* scoped to .speaker). SaaS and Minimalist styles keep their own scoped tokens and are not covered. Component snippets resolve tokens to light-scheme literals because the tokens are not on :root.

display.purpose: Hero h1 only: one short sentence, balanced wrap, 20px above the intro.

intro.purpose: First hero intro paragraph, in ink, 32em measure; backs the headline.

headline.purpose: Section titles, stacked above their content.

title.purpose: Entry titles, the popover title (speaker-text-on) and the glass label; the top-bar name (plain text) at 17px/700, -0.01em.

lead.purpose: Second hero intro paragraph and the facts sentence, in ink-2, 32em measure.

label.purpose: 15px catalog workhorse: keys, selector hint, outcome and achievement lines (plain, no bold figures), meta (tabular), chips, group headings.

rail-label.purpose: Speaker style buttons at every width (13px/600), legends printed on the device; flex 1 1 auto with 0 10px padding.

tip.purpose: 13px/600 pill tip beside the corner egg (ground text on ink).

shadows.name: popover-float
shadows.purpose: Night popover with a faint white ring, over a light scrim.

shadows.name: speaker-glow
shadows.value: filter: drop-shadow(-8px 8px 20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--sp-glow-a) 7%, transparent)) drop-shadow(10px 14px 24px color-mix(in srgb, var(--sp-glow-b) 9%, transparent)) drop-shadow(0 18px 22px var(--cast))
shadows.purpose: Faint teal and violet glows over a neutral cast beneath the whole speaker.

shadows.name: speaker-rim
shadows.value: inset 0 2px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14), inset 10px 0 22px -18px color-mix(in srgb, var(--sp-glow-a) 30%, transparent), inset -10px 0 22px -16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--sp-glow-b) 34%, transparent), inset 0 -8px 16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35)
shadows.purpose: Top-lit face with teal rim light from the left and violet from the right.

shadows.name: button-rail
shadows.purpose: Recessed pill track for the style buttons.

shadows.name: rail-pill
shadows.purpose: The one pill that slides under the pressed rail label.

shadows.name: egg-open
shadows.value: inset 0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5), 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--signal) 40%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Egg face while the popover is open (.mk:has(#style-speaker:popover-open)).

shadows.name: key-lip
shadows.purpose: Raised key at rest, standing 3px proud.

shadows.name: key-hover
shadows.value: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.55), 0 0 0 1px var(--ink-2), 0 5px 0 var(--rule), 0 16px 22px -10px var(--cast); translate 0 -2px; highlight sweep linear-gradient(105deg, transparent 38%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.55) 50%, transparent 62%) from 130% to -30%
shadows.purpose: Raised key hover: rises onto a 5px lip as light sweeps across its face.

shadows.name: key-flat
shadows.purpose: Flat key; ink-2 outline on hover and :active (translate 0 1px).

shadows.name: focus
shadows.value: outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px (4px on the egg, following its 30% corners)
shadows.purpose: Focus-visible on page links, keys and the egg; --focus is #c43d00 light, #ff6a1a dark, >=3:1 on the plastics.

shadows.name: focus-speaker
shadows.purpose: Focus-visible on the speaker's rail buttons and glass.

motion.name: duration
motion.purpose: translate and box-shadow on the flat key and arrows; the raised key uses 180ms plus a 700ms background-position sweep; only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: egg-tip
motion.purpose: Pill tip beside the egg on hover or focus.

motion.name: egg-hover-open
motion.value: open after 220ms of rest; close 450ms after leaving egg and popover (unless focus is inside); mouse only

motion.name: egg-wiggle
motion.value: rotate -8deg (25%), 6deg (60%) over 520ms on the house ease

motion.name: popover-grow
motion.value: opacity 220ms; scale 0.6 -> 1 and translate 0 24px -> 0 over 320ms; @starting-style; overlay/display 320ms allow-discrete; transform-origin bottom right
motion.purpose: Speaker popover grows out of the egg.

motion.name: card-open
motion.value: opacity + translate 0 4px -> 0 over 140ms, after a 300ms delay (fade and rise only without reduced motion)
motion.purpose: Company card opens on hover or focus-within.

motion.name: card-close
motion.value: 140ms, no delay; visibility flips after 140ms; Escape hides it until pointer or focus leaves the name (src/scripts/company-cards.ts)
motion.purpose: Company card closes; an invisible bridge keeps it open while the pointer travels down.

motion.name: rail-pill-slide
motion.value: translate + width over 320ms on the house ease; --pill-x / --pill-w set by speaker.ts from the pressed button
motion.purpose: Rail pill follows the pressed label.

motion.name: glass-label
motion.value: label opacity + scale 0.96 -> 1 over 200ms whenever it has text; the preview never fades
motion.purpose: Grille label: always visible when it has text (You’re already here on the current style).

motion.name: preview-grow
motion.value: ::view-transition-group(style-preview) 640ms house ease; old 320ms ease-in fade; new 640ms from 0.6 opacity
motion.purpose: The grille (view-transition-name style-preview) grows into the target panel on confirm (switchStyle morphFrom).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No transitions, no wiggle, no view transition: the popover and cards appear in place, the rail pill jumps, the preview and glass label change without fading, and the style switches instantly.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: --pad 32px; speaker min(100%, 340px) in the popover; entry meta moves to the right; below it the company card spans its row under the title.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: --pad 48px; hero gap 56px; hero top padding 64px; sections 112px apart. Still one column.

previews.source: screenshots of the live sites (trustyou.com, cognizant.com/us/en, capitole-consulting.com, bsc.es) at 1280x800, cookies declined; BSC temporary maintenance notice hidden before capture

speaker.geometry: static CSS 3D: rotateX(8deg) rotateY(-14deg), perspective 1100px; 10 slices 2.6px apart behind a 34% squircle face (corner-shape: squircle, rounded fallback); face padding 8%, gap 6%; concentric squircles: popover 32px, face 34%, grille 28%, rail 24px, pill and buttons 20px
speaker.palette: deep teal plastics (--sp*) shared by speaker and egg, same in both schemes; studio glows --sp-glow-a teal rgb(38 230 190) left and --sp-glow-b violet rgb(124 92 255) right, kept low (drop shadows 7%/9% over a neutral cast, rims 30%/34%, slice edges 28%/32%, popover glows 7%/9%); popover ground --sp-night #0b1d26
speaker.grille: 28% squircle; always shows the picked style's panel as an inert clone rendered at 1280px and scaled to the grille width (the Marketing clone drops its egg and popover), over a dotted speaker-hole backing; the grille is itself a transparent button whose label reads copy.glassLabels (See as a SaaS / Go minimalist), or stays up as You're already here (disabled) on the current style
speaker.behaviour: mouse (hover: hover and pointer: fine): resting on the egg opens the popover after 220ms, leaving egg and popover closes it after 450ms unless focus is inside, a click on the egg toggles (and keeps a hover-opened popover open); pointing at or focusing a style label previews it (aria-pressed, pill slides) and clicking it switches via switchStyle(style, { morphFrom: grille }); the grille button (disabled on the current style) confirms too. Touch: tap the egg, tap a style

layout.columns: one at every width; hero = headline, intro, facts; keys only in the footer
layout.sections: heading over content, 16px gap, 64px apart (112px from 1024)
layout.dividers: only the 1px rule between experience and project rows
layout.fixedLayer: egg fixed 20px from bottom right; speaker popover fixed 20px right / 92px bottom, min(420px, 100vw - 40px), max-height 100vh - 120px
layout.links: every link opens in a new tab (target _blank, rel noopener), in all three styles

components.name: Raised Key
components.description: The primary route (Say hi on LinkedIn): a keycap on a 3px lip that rises to 5px with a highlight sweep on hover and is pressed down to 1px on :active.
components.html: Say hi on LinkedIn

components.name: Flat Key
components.description: The quieter route (See my work on GitHub): transparent with a hairline outline.
components.html: See my work on GitHub
components.css: .ds-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: "Schibsted Grotesk Variable", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #232526; text-decoration: none; transition: translate 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c43d00; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-key--flat { font-weight: 500; background: transparent; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #a3a6a3; } .ds-key--flat:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #4a4d4f; } .ds-key--flat:active { translate: 0 1px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #4a4d4f; }

components.name: Easter Egg
components.description: On a mouse, resting on it opens the speaker after 220ms and leaving egg and popover closes it after 450ms; a click toggles. 56px corner button fixed 20px from the bottom right: a tiny deep-teal speaker (34% squircle, 5px dot grille, top-lit). While the popover is open the face sinks and takes a 3px signal-40% ring (.mk:has(#style-speaker:popover-open); the snippet uses aria-expanded as a stand-in). Hover or focus shows the pill tip to its left; hover wiggles it (520ms). Opens the speaker popover (popovertarget).

narrative.overview:
This file documents the **Marketing** style only: the default panel of the single-page site, built in `src/components/marketing/MarketingPage.astro`, with every token scoped to its `.mk` root. The site has two other permanent, switchable styles, SaaS (`src/components/saas/SaasPage.astro`) and Minimalist (`src/components/minimalist/MinimalistPage.astro`). Each scopes its own tokens, and nothing here covers them beyond one shared behaviour: every link opens in a new tab. Do not apply these tokens outside the Marketing panel.

The Marketing style presents a person the way a catalog presents a well-made appliance. The ground is cool matte grey plastic and ink is graphite. One signal orange marks the things you operate. The page is a single calm column of plain reading. The hero is a headline, an intro, and one sentence of facts. Below it, the experience, project and stack lists use space instead of dividers, grey labels and tabular figures. Each company name opens a card showing its homepage, and the footer holds the two keys for the next step.

The style switcher is an easter egg. A tiny deep teal speaker sits in the bottom-right corner. Resting on it with a mouse, or tapping it, grows it into a dark night-sky popover holding the full speaker. The speaker is a deep teal moulded squircle with no brand mark, lit like a studio product shot: teal rim light from the left, violet from the right, and coloured glows beneath it. A button rail on its face names the styles. Pointing at or focusing one previews it live in the grille, and clicking it switches straight away: one click with a mouse, two taps on touch.

Hierarchy comes from one grotesk family varied by weight and size, never from colour. Depth is physical but sparing: the egg and the speaker are objects, the raised key has a real lip, and the popover and company cards float. Everything else is flat. The dark scheme is the same appliance in charcoal plastic with the same orange. The teal speaker and its night popover are the same in both schemes.

The direction named brushed aluminium, hairline spec tables and an off-centre rail. The build has none of these. It is one column, there are no aluminium parts, and the only drawn line is the rule between list rows. The dot-grid grille survives as the backing behind the speaker's live preview and on the egg's face.
keyCharacteristics: One signal orange, reserved for operable things.
One type family (Schibsted Grotesk Variable); hierarchy by weight and size.
One 820px column at every width; sections stack heading over content.
Space instead of dividers: the only drawn line is the 1px rule between list rows.
The style switcher hides in a corner easter egg and opens as a teal speaker on a night-sky popover.
Company names open a floating card that is just the company's homepage.

rules.name: The Operable Orange Rule
rules.body: Signal orange marks only things you can operate or are operating: the open egg's ring, hovered link affordances, and selection (focus uses its deeper sibling, `focus`). It is never a text fill and never decoration, and nothing on the page pulses or glows orange.

rules.name: The Readable Focus Rule
rules.body: On the page ground, focus rings use `focus`, not `signal`, so they hold at least 3:1 against every plastic in both schemes. On the speaker and inside the night popover, focus flips to a 2px `speaker-text-on` ring. Never use the bright orange for focus in light.

rules.name: The Studio-Light Rule
rules.body: The speaker is lit by two coloured lights, teal from the left and violet from the right. Its rim light, slice edges, glows and the popover's ambience all follow that split. The glows are always mixed down, never solid, and never leave the speaker family.

rules.name: The Two-Plastics Rule
rules.body: Every ground, panel, ink, rule, signal and focus token has a dark sibling, and the dark scheme changes the plastic, not the voice. The speaker family is the exception: a self-lit object on its own night surface, the same in both schemes. The orange shifts only slightly (`signal` to `signal-dark`), and every orange tint is mixed from `signal` so it follows.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Only Schibsted Grotesk appears. Contrast comes from weight (400 to 700), size, and the `ink`/`ink-2` pair. No second face, no italics for emphasis.

rules.name: The Spec-Sheet Size Rule
rules.body: Anything that labels, measures or dates on the page sits at 15px. New metadata joins that size rather than inventing a smaller one. The only smaller type is printed on objects: the 13px rail labels on the speaker, and the 13px tip beside the egg.

rules.name: The Facts-As-Prose Rule
rules.body: Plain facts about the person (years, location, way of working) are written as one sentence in the Lead role, not as a stat grid. Results are stated plainly, without bold figures.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: Everything stacks in one 820px column, in reading order. No side-by-side columns, no split, no rail. The only thing outside the column is the corner egg and its popover.

rules.name: The Space-Not-Lines Rule
rules.body: Space separates blocks. The only drawn divider is the 1px `rule` between rows inside the experience and project lists. No borders under the bar, above lists, tool groups or the footer, and no vertical lines.

rules.name: The Top-Lit Rule
rules.body: Light comes from above. Highlights sit on top edges, and shadows fall below with negative spread so they stay under the object, never around it.

rules.name: The Travel Rule
rules.body: Hard-edged lips belong only to solid objects that move. The raised key stands on a 3px lip, rises to 5px on hover, and is pressed down to 1px. Don't use zero-blur offsets on anything that doesn't move.

rules.name: The No-Housing Rule
rules.body: On the page, controls sit directly on the ground; don't wrap them in cards or shadowed panels. The only floating surfaces are transient: the night popover that holds the speaker, and the company cards.

rules.name: The Squircle Rule
rules.body: Objects in the speaker family are concentric squircles (`corner-shape: squircle`): each inner shape's radius steps down with its inset (popover 32px, face 34%, grille 28%, rail 24px, pill and buttons 20px). Plain rounded corners are the fallback. Page elements keep ordinary rounded corners.

dos: **Do** reserve `signal` orange for operable things: the open egg's ring, hovered link affordances, selection. Mix any orange tint from `signal`.
**Do** draw focus rings with `focus` (3px outline, 3px offset) on the ground, and with `speaker-text-on` (2px) on the speaker and night surfaces.
**Do** keep everything in the one 820px column: heading over content, 112px between sections on wide screens.
**Do** separate blocks with space, and list rows with a single 1px `rule`; set meta at 15px in tabular figures.
**Do** state plain facts and results as plain sentences, with numbers computed rather than hard-coded and not bolded.
**Do** turn a company name into an underlined keyword link whose hover card is the company's homepage screenshot, captured from the live site.
**Do** make hover cards and popovers dismissable with Escape and calm under reduced motion.
**Do** keep style switching to one click on a mouse: hover opens, pointing previews, clicking switches. On touch, keep it to two taps.
**Do** open every link in a new tab (`target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener"`).
**Do** give the primary action the raised key (12px corners, 48px minimum height, key lip, 2px travel) and secondary routes the flat key.
**Do** declare a dark sibling for every new scheme-dependent colour token under `prefers-color-scheme: dark`.
**Do** light anything in the speaker family with the teal-left, violet-right studio pair, mixed down from `speaker-glow-teal` and `speaker-glow-violet`, and give it concentric squircle corners.
**Do** keep motion short and mechanical on `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`, inside `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.
donts: **Don't** fill text with `signal` orange, or use it as decoration.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface or set hierarchy by colour alone.
**Don't** split the page into columns or draw dividers beyond the row rule.
**Don't** use zero-blur offset shadows on anything that doesn't move. The key lip is the only one.
**Don't** add decorative dials, brand marks or controls that don't do anything. Every control on the page is real.
**Don't** apply these tokens to the SaaS or Minimalist panels. Each style keeps its own scoped tokens.
